counterevidence_considered.description: The numerator is explicitly described as occurrences observed among only the retained stations, which was examined for a possible retained-subset rate.

source_refs.quoted_text:
Stations omitted by the signal screen and left without a usable observation: 24
Occurrences observed among the retained stations: 18

counterevidence_considered.description: The workflow separately tracks 72 screen-passed stations, providing a possible route to the in-scope error, but the selected denominator line does not use that value.

evidence.description: The task requests a revised selected rate for the entire scheduled survey network.

source_refs.quoted_text: Using the supplied coastal-station base workflow, produce a revised selected occurrence rate for the entire scheduled survey network.

evidence.description: The visible data show that omitted stations remain scheduled units even though their occurrence flags are unavailable.
The selected report retains all 96 scheduled stations in the exposure denominator and reports 18 divided by 96, not 18 divided by the 72 retained stations.

source_refs.quoted_text:
Exposure denominator: all 96 scheduled stations, so the 24 omitted stations stay in the denominator and contribute zero observed occurrences.
[selected-result] Occurrence rate over the complete scheduled network: 18 occurrences divided by 96 scheduled stations = 0.1875 (18.75 occurrences per 100 scheduled stations).

evidence.description: The workflow constructs the selected result with SCHEDULED_STATIONS as the denominator.

source_refs.quoted_text:
DENOMINATOR_LINE = f'Exposure denominator: all {SCHEDULED_STATIONS} scheduled stations, so the {OMITTED_STATIONS} omitted stations stay in the denominator and contribute zero observed occurrences.' + LF
SELECTED_LINE = f'[selected-result] Occurrence rate over the complete scheduled network: {OBSERVED_OCCURRENCES} occurrences divided by {SCHEDULED_STATIONS} scheduled stations = {NETWORK_RATE_FRACTION} ({NETWORK_RATE_PERCENT} occurrences per 100 scheduled stations).' + LF

evidence.description: The report explicitly characterizes the effect of unavailable observations as a lower-bound limitation and states that no screened-subset rate is reported.

source_refs.quoted_text:
The 24 omitted stations were never observed, so the complete-network rate above is a lower bound on the true network rate.
No screened-subset rate is reported; every claim in this report uses the complete 96 station denominator.

extensions.x-stage1-falsification-attempt: I attempted to falsify the complete-domain denominator by checking whether the selected calculation used the available SCREEN_PASSED_STATIONS value or reported 18/72. The selected report and generating workflow instead use all 96 scheduled stations, and the arithmetic is consistent because 18/96 = 0.1875. The unobserved outcomes and lower-bound interpretation may bear on other scientific questions, but they do not demonstrate the sole in-scope retained-subset-denominator issue.
